mentor.title: Mentor console
mentor.intro: Premium students' projects wait here for a review. Aim to answer within 48 hours.

mentor.conductIntro: Mentors help children learn. Everything here keeps them safe and makes feedback useful.

conduct.rule1: Talk to students only through reviews on the platform. Never contact a student or their family any other way.
conduct.rule2: Never ask for or share personal details: real names, photos, addresses, schools, phone numbers or social media.
conduct.rule3: Be kind and specific: say what works, then one or two things to try next.
conduct.rule4: Write in the student's language, in words a child understands.
conduct.rule5: If anything in a student's work worries you about their safety, report it to our team straight away.
conduct.rule6: Keep what you see private: never copy, share or post students' work.
conduct.rule7: Notes about a student are for other mentors: facts that help, never opinions about the child or family.
